steps: Play the story through all five chapters — the 12 story trophies pop as you go.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth. It may be the game's only missable trophy.
Take optional and side-character missions as they appear; scan vehicles and study animals as you travel.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. There is no mission replay.
Leave cheats off — they disable trophies and saving.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first

steps: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — the checklist is finally visible.
Work the checklist: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 stunts.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the hardest ten.
Finish every robbery, the 42 Shooting Range golds, all 14 drone races and Bret's quest.
The thresholds are lenient: 100% is closer to 60% true completion.
stages.title: Stage 2 — 100% completion

steps: Finish the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and any side-character questlines left.
Clean up collectibles: three card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 52 areas of Leonida.
Mop up the money trophies — laundering, spending and the eight garages.
Sweep the one-off feats: Combat Focus, VCIA, the Rhinos, the showroom and the secrets.
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! follows — the platinum is yours.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & cleanup

warnings.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. Once a story mission is done you cannot select it again, so keep one manual save at the start of each chapter and one from just before the final mission.
warnings.title: Save before every chapter

warnings.text: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 is the only trophy that may be missable. Do it the morning after Down to Earth, and keep your Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops. It is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it to be safe.
warnings.title: The one possible missable

warnings.text: Cheats only work after the story, and using one disables trophies, achievements and saving. Never use a cheat on your trophy save.
warnings.title: Cheats switch trophies off
